name: Vail (United States)
description: Horizontal tricolour of light blue, white and dark green, charged at the centre with the yellow Vail emblem of two nested Vs within a wreath.
history: Vail is a home rule municipality in Eagle County, Colorado. English Wikipedia explains the light blue as the Colorado sky, the white as powder snow and the green as the mountains, with the two Vs of the emblem standing for the mountains and the Vail Valley.

features.role: Vail emblem of two nested Vs within a wreath
